task: First attempt of the LLM->Blender render task (astra-blender-ship v1) scored 0.0
root_cause: Prompt told the LLM to enable denoising with a try/except guard - assignment succeeds but the apt Blender 4.3.2 build lacks OpenImageDenoise, so bpy.ops.render.render() aborts at render time with RuntimeError: Failed to denoise, build has no OpenImageDenoise support
Dataset metadata file written as datasets-metadata.json (plural) but kaggle CLI requires dataset-metadata.json (singular) - export failed with Metadata file not found
what_i_did_wrong: Trusted a try/except guard to cover an optional render feature that only fails at render time, and did not verify the exact metadata filename required by the kaggle datasets CLI before pushing
corrective_actions: v2: prompt explicitly forbids denoising + regex force-replace use_denoising = True -> False in generated code
v2: added TELEMETRY expectation channel so every future failure self-reports env facts (python, blender version, env vars, rc codes)
outcome_after_fix: v2 rendered PNG successfully; v3 reached score 1.0
